question:
The brain is compared to what?

[UPASI 05.12.2021 (Shift-II)]
options: Scientists
Mind
Computer
Science
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Computer

Explanation:
The human brain is often compared to a computer because both possess remarkable information processing capabilities. Just as a computer takes input, processes it, and produces output, the human brain receives information from sensory organs, processes it, and generates responses. Both systems feature memory storage mechanisms, decision-making abilities, and the capacity to perform complex computations. This analogy has formed the foundation for developing Artificial Intelligence and Neural Networks, where computer systems are designed inspired by the structure and functioning of the human brain.

Extra Facts:
The comparison between computers and the brain is significant in fields like Cognitive Science and Computational Neuroscience. Neurons in the brain function similarly to transistors in computers. Machine Learning algorithms mimic human learning processes. However, the brain still far surpasses computers in energy efficiency and parallel processing capabilities. The Von Neumann Architecture also establishes similarities between brain and computer operations.

question_hi:
मस्तिष्क की तुलना किससे की जाती है?

[UPASI 05.12.2021 (Shift-II)]
options_hi: वैज्ञानिकों से
मन से
कंप्यूटर से
विज्ञान से
solution_hi:
हल: सही उत्तर है कंप्यूटर

Explanation:
मानव मस्तिष्क की तुलना अक्सर कंप्यूटर से की जाती है क्योंकि दोनों में सूचना प्रसंस्करण की अद्भुत क्षमता होती है। जिस प्रकार कंप्यूटर इनपुट लेता है, प्रोसेस करता है और आउटपुट देता है, ठीक उसी प्रकार मानव मस्तिष्क संवेदी अंगों से जानकारी प्राप्त करता है, उसे प्रोसेस करता है और प्रतिक्रिया उत्पन्न करता है। दोनों में मेमोरी स्टोरेज सिस्टम, निर्णय लेने की क्षमता और जटिल गणनाएँ करने की क्षमता होती है। यह तुलना आर्टिफिशियल इंटेलिजेंस और न्यूरल नेटवर्क्स के विकास का आधार बनी है, जहाँ कंप्यूटर सिस्टम को मानव मस्तिष्क की संरचना और कार्यप्रणाली से प्रेरित कर डिज़ाइन किया जाता है।

Extra Facts:
कंप्यूटर और मस्तिष्क की तुलना कॉग्निटिव साइंस और कम्प्यूटेशनल न्यूरोसाइंस के क्षेत्र में महत्वपूर्ण है। मस्तिष्क के न्यूरॉन्स कंप्यूटर के ट्रांजिस्टर्स के समान कार्य करते हैं। मशीन लर्निंग एल्गोरिदम मानव सीखने की प्रक्रिया की नकल करते हैं। हालाँकि, मस्तिष्क ऊर्जा दक्षता और समानांतर प्रसंस्करण में अभी भी कंप्यूटरों से कहीं आगे है। वॉन न्यूमैन आर्किटेक्चर भी मस्तिष्क और कंप्यूटर के बीच समानता स्थापित करता है।

question:
Which of the following is correct for Digital Circuits?

[BPSC TRE 3.0 Exam-2024 (11-12)]
options: They use analog signals for communication
They process information using continuous voltage levels
They are not suitable for high speed operations
More than one of the above
None of the above
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is None of the above

Explanation:
Digital circuits operate on binary system principles, using only two states - 0 and 1 (low and high voltage levels). They do not use analog signals but rather process digital signals. Instead of continuous voltage levels, digital circuits work with discrete voltage levels. They are highly suitable for high-speed operations because digital signal processing is faster and less susceptible to noise. Therefore, all given options are incorrect.

Extra Facts:
Digital circuits are built from logic gates (AND, OR, NOT, NAND, NOR, XOR, XNOR) and operate on Boolean algebra principles. They are fundamental components in computers, smartphones, digital watches, etc. Digital systems have better noise immunity compared to analog systems. VLSI (Very Large Scale Integration) technology has enabled complex digital circuits to be integrated into small chips.

solution_hi:
हल: सही उत्तर है उपर्युक्त में से कोई नहीं

Explanation:
डिजिटल सर्किट बाइनरी सिस्टम पर काम करते हैं, जो केवल दो अवस्थाओं - 0 और 1 (लो और हाई वोल्टेज) का उपयोग करते हैं। ये एनालॉग सिग्नल का उपयोग नहीं करते, बल्कि डिजिटल सिग्नल का उपयोग करते हैं। डिजिटल सर्किट निरंतर वोल्टेज स्तर के बजाय असतत वोल्टेज स्तर पर कार्य करते हैं। ये उच्च गति संचालन के लिए अत्यधिक उपयुक्त हैं क्योंकि इनमें सिग्नल प्रोसेसिंग तेज और शोर के प्रति कम संवेदनशील होती है। इस प्रकार दिए गए सभी विकल्प गलत हैं।

Extra Facts:
डिजिटल सर्किट लॉजिक गेट्स (AND, OR, NOT, NAND, NOR, XOR, XNOR) से बनते हैं और बूलियन अलजेब्रा के सिद्धांतों पर काम करते हैं। ये कंप्यूटर, स्मार्टफोन, डिजिटल घड़ियाँ आदि में मुख्य घटक हैं। डिजिटल सिस्टम की शोर अवरोध क्षमता एनालॉग सिस्टम से बेहतर होती है। VLSI (Very Large Scale Integration) तकनीक ने जटिल डिजिटल सर्किट को छोटे चिप्स में समेटना संभव बनाया है।

question:
All the arithmetic and logical operations in a computer are done by.............

[UPSSSC Auditor 05.01.2025, SSC JE Electrical (Exam date 27.01.2018) Shift-II]
options: ALU
CU
Register
No option is correct.
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is ALU

Explanation:
All arithmetic (addition, subtraction, multiplication, division) and logical (AND, OR, NOT, XOR) operations in a computer are performed by the ALU (Arithmetic Logic Unit). The ALU is a fundamental component of the Central Processing Unit (CPU). It is the part of the processor that performs the actual calculations and comparisons on data. The Control Unit (CU) is responsible for decoding instructions and controlling operations, while Registers are high-speed memory locations used for temporarily storing data and instructions. Therefore, the ALU is specifically responsible for arithmetic and logic functions.

Extra Facts:
The CPU is often called the brain of the computer and primarily consists of three parts: the ALU, CU, and Registers/Memory Unit. The design of the ALU directly impacts the processing power of a computer. Modern CPUs often contain multiple ALUs. The Control Unit coordinates all the resources of the system, such as I/O devices, memory, and the ALU. Registers are the fastest memory inside the CPU and are used to immediately access data being used by the ALU.

कंप्यूटर में सभी अंकगणितीय (जोड़, घटाव, गुणा, भाग) और तार्किक (AND, OR, NOT, XOR) परिचालन ALU (Arithmetic Logic Unit) द्वारा किए जाते हैं। ALU, Central Processing Unit (CPU) का एक मौलिक भाग है। यह प्रोसेसर का वह घटक है जो डेटा पर वास्तविक गणना और तुलना करता है। Control Unit (CU) का कार्य निर्देशों को डिकोड करना और संचालनों को नियंत्रित करना है, जबकि Register डेटा और निर्देशों को अस्थायी रूप से संग्रहीत करने के लिए उच्च-गति वाली मेमोरी लोकेशन हैं। इसलिए, अंकगणित और तर्क संबंधी कार्यों के लिए ALU ही जिम्मेदार है।

question:
Which of the following part of a processor contains the hardware necessary to perform all the operations required by a computer?

[UPSSSC X-Ray Technician 15.12.2024]
options: Registers
Controller
Data Path
Cache
None of the above
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Data Path

Explanation:
The Data Path of a processor contains the hardware necessary to perform all computational operations required by a computer. It includes components like the Arithmetic Logic Unit (ALU), registers, and internal buses that enable data flow and processing. While the Controller decodes instructions and generates control signals, and Cache temporarily stores data, the Data Path is the actual pathway where data manipulation occurs. It's the core component that executes arithmetic, logical, and data transfer operations, making it essential for all computer operations.

Extra Facts:
Data Path design is a critical aspect of computer architecture that determines how data moves between different processor components. RISC (Reduced Instruction Set Computer) and CISC (Complex Instruction Set Computer) architectures feature different data path designs. The efficiency of the data path directly impacts processor performance since it handles the execution phase of the instruction cycle. Modern processors often feature pipelined data paths that allow multiple instructions to be processed simultaneously, significantly improving throughput and performance.

question:
From the following, where does the actual instruction execute during data processing?

[AHC ARO 2019 (Exam date 24.02.2019)]
options: Arithmetic logic unit
Information unit
Storage unit
Output unit
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Arithmetic logic unit

Explanation:
During data processing, actual instructions are executed in the Arithmetic Logic Unit (ALU). The ALU is a fundamental component of the Central Processing Unit (CPU) that performs all arithmetic calculations (addition, subtraction, multiplication, division) and logical operations (AND, OR, NOT). When a computer receives an instruction, the Control Unit decodes it and sends it to the ALU where actual processing occurs. The Storage Unit only stores data, the Output Unit displays results, and Information Unit is not a standard computer component.

Extra Facts:
The ALU consists of two main parts: the Arithmetic Unit and the Logic Unit. It operates on the binary number system and uses registers to temporarily store data. ALU performance plays a crucial role in determining computer speed and capability. Modern microprocessors may contain multiple ALUs that enable parallel processing, resulting in significant improvement in computing power.

question:

solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Arithmetic Logic Unit

Explanation:
The ALU (Arithmetic Logic Unit) is a fundamental component of the computer's Central Processing Unit (CPU) that performs all arithmetic and logical operations. It executes arithmetic operations like addition, subtraction, multiplication, division and logical operations such as AND, OR, NOT, XOR. The ALU processes input data to generate output and works in coordination with the Control Unit. It plays a crucial role in determining the speed and capability of a computer. The efficiency of the ALU is a key factor in measuring processor performance.

Extra Facts:
The CPU consists of three main components: ALU (Arithmetic Logic Unit), CU (Control Unit), and Memory Unit. The ALU operates on the binary number system and uses registers to temporarily store data. Modern processors contain multiple ALUs that facilitate parallel processing. The clock speed of the ALU determines the overall speed of the processor. It is an essential element of computer architecture that functions according to the Von Neumann architecture.

solution:

Word length refers to the number of bits a processor can handle simultaneously in its internal operations. This directly impacts the performance and efficiency of the processor. Extra Facts:
Word length is a fundamental component of computer architecture. It determines address bus width, memory access capability, and register size. question:
Arrange the following in ascending order of size.

[UPPCL TG-II 20-03-2021 (Shift-I)]
options: MFLOPS, GFLOPS, TFLOPS
TFLOPS, MFLOPS, GFLOPS
MFLOPS, TFLOPS, GFLOPS
GFLOPS, TFLOPS, MFLOPS
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is MFLOPS, GFLOPS, TFLOPS

Explanation:
FLOPS (Floating Point Operations Per Second) is a unit for measuring computer performance that indicates processing capability. The size of these units is determined by their numerical values: 1 MFLOPS = 10⁶ FLOPS, 1 GFLOPS = 10⁹ FLOPS, and 1 TFLOPS = 10¹² FLOPS. Since 10⁶ < 10⁹ < 10¹², the ascending order will be MFLOPS → GFLOPS → TFLOPS. This order is significant in supercomputing and high-performance computing, where calculation speed is crucial for scientific research and data analytics.

Extra Facts:
FLOPS is a standard measurement in computer architecture and processor design. Supercomputers are typically measured in TFLOPS or PFLOPS (PetaFLOPS). According to Moore's Law, processor capacity doubles every two years, causing FLOPS units to rapidly increase. New technologies like quantum computing and AI accelerators are now reaching EFLOPS (ExaFLOPS) levels, which is significant for future computing.

brain of the computer
heart of the computer
backbone of the computer
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is brain of the computer

Explanation:
The CPU (Central Processing Unit) is called the brain of the computer because it is the primary component responsible for processing data and executing instructions. Just as the human brain controls and coordinates all body functions, the CPU controls all operations of the computer system. It performs three key functions: fetching instructions from memory, decoding them to understand what needs to be done, and then executing them. The CPU performs arithmetic and logical calculations (via the ALU) and manages data flow between memory and input/output devices. Its speed and efficiency directly determine the overall performance of the computer.

Extra Facts:
The CPU primarily consists of three components: the ALU (Arithmetic Logic Unit), the Control Unit (CU), and Registers. The ALU handles all calculations and comparisons, while the Control Unit directs the flow of data between all system resources. CPU speed is measured in Hertz (Hz). Modern CPUs are multi-core (e.g., dual-core, quad-core), enabling them to process multiple tasks simultaneously, a capability known as parallel processing. This significantly enhances computing power and efficiency for complex applications.

question:
Which of the following is not a part of operation of instruction cycle?

[AHC ARO 2019 (Exam date 24.02.2019)]
options: Fetch
Indirect
Execute
Memory
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Memory

Explanation:
The instruction cycle is the fundamental process performed by a computer's CPU to process program instructions. This cycle primarily consists of three stages: Fetch (retrieving the instruction from memory), Decode (interpreting the instruction), and Execute (carrying out the instruction). Indirect is an addressing mode that can occur during the instruction cycle where the actual operand address is obtained indirectly. However, Memory itself is not a stage of the instruction cycle but rather a hardware component used to store data and instructions during the cycle.

Extra Facts:
The instruction cycle is a fundamental principle of computer architecture proposed by John von Neumann. The CPU can complete millions of instruction cycles per second, measured in IPS (Instructions Per Second). In case of an interrupt, the instruction cycle may temporarily halt. Cache memory is used to speed up the fetch stage. Pipelining technique optimizes performance by processing stages of multiple instructions simultaneously.

question:

solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is CPU

Explanation:
Main Memory, or primary memory, works in direct coordination with the CPU (Central Processing Unit). The CPU is the brain of the computer that executes all instructions. Main Memory, which includes RAM (Random Access Memory), acts as a active workspace to provide the CPU with fast access to data and instructions. When a program runs, its instructions and data are first loaded into the main memory, and the CPU reads from and writes to this memory directly. This direct access is crucial for the computer's speed and efficiency. Other options, like a special function card or Intel (a company name), are not part of this core coordination mechanism of the main memory.

Extra Facts:
Main Memory is also called volatile memory because the data stored in it is lost when the power is turned off. It is different from Secondary Memory (like HDD, SSD), which stores data permanently. Data transfer between the CPU and Main Memory occurs via the system bus. Cache Memory, located inside the CPU, further speeds up this coordination. The Operating System performs memory management, deciding what data is placed where and when. This memory hierarchy helps optimize computer performance.

The ALU works in conjunction with the Control Unit and registers in computer architecture. It operates on the binary number system and executes machine-level instructions. Modern microprocessors may contain multiple ALUs that enable parallel processing. The design of ALU directly impacts the performance capability of a computer and it is based on digital logic circuits. ALU operations are controlled by the CPU's control unit which directs data flow between ALU and other components.

Extra Facts:
ALU कंप्यूटर आर्किटेक्चर में नियंत्रण इकाई (Control Unit) और रजिस्टरों के साथ मिलकर कार्य करता है। यह बाइनरी संख्या प्रणाली पर कार्य करता है और मशीन स्तर के निर्देशों को निष्पादित करता है। आधुनिक माइक्रोप्रोसेसरों में एक से अधिक ALU हो सकते हैं जो समानांतर प्रसंस्करण को सक्षम बनाते हैं। ALU का डिजाइन कंप्यूटर की प्रदर्शन क्षमता को सीधे प्रभावित करता है और यह डिजिटल लॉजिक सर्किट्स पर आधारित होता है।

Moore's Law states that the number of transistors on a processor doubles approximately every two years. The CPU has three main components: ALU (Arithmetic Logic Unit), Control Unit, and Registers. Modern CPUs use cache memory to increase data access speed. The evolution from vacuum tubes to transistors revolutionized computer technology, making computers smaller, faster, and more reliable.

question:
Which of the following is an example of a digital Electronic?

[BPSC TRE 3.0 Exam-2024]
options: Computers
Mobile phones
Digital cameras
More than one of the above
None of the above
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is More than one of the above

Explanation:
Digital Electronics refers to devices that use digital signals, where data is represented in the form of binary digits (0s and 1s). A computer is a prime example of digital electronics as it processes all data in binary code. Similarly, mobile phones and digital cameras also operate on digital principles; mobile phones use digital communication protocols, and digital cameras capture and store images as digital files. Since all three options fall under digital electronics, the correct answer is 'More than one of the above'. This question tests fundamental understanding of computer fundamentals and electronics.

Extra Facts:
Digital Electronics is the backbone of modern technology, based on microprocessors, memory chips, and logic gates. Unlike analog electronics which uses continuous signals, digital systems are less susceptible to noise and offer better data accuracy. Boolean Algebra forms the foundation of digital circuit design. Computers, smartphones, digital TVs, and GPS devices are all examples of digital electronics. Digital technology has revolutionized fields like computer networking, database management, and programming, enabling high speed, reliability, and efficiency.

question:

Data processing/resource

Explanation:
The CPU (Central Processing Unit) is the primary processing component of a computer that performs fetching instructions, interpreting instructions (decoding), and data processing (execution). It controls all arithmetic and logical operations in the computer. However, permanently storing data is not a function of the CPU - this task is performed by storage devices such as hard disks, SSDs, or other memory devices. The CPU only uses cache memory and registers for temporary data but does not provide permanent storage.

Extra Facts:
The main components of CPU include ALU (Arithmetic Logic Unit) and CU (Control Unit). ALU performs all mathematical and logical operations, while CU coordinates all processing activities. CPU speed is measured in Hertz (Hz) and modern CPUs are multi-core processors. The computer memory hierarchy includes registers (fastest), cache, RAM, and finally permanent storage devices.

question:
Which of the following storage devices directly interacts with the CPU?

[UPPCL AC 2019 (Exam Date 29.01.2019)]
options: Tertiary Storage
Secondary, Storage
Primary Storage
Hard Disk
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Primary Storage

Explanation:
Primary Storage, also known as main memory or RAM (Random Access Memory), directly interacts with the CPU. This is the memory where currently executing programs and data are stored. The CPU needs it for fast data access. Due to its direct connection via the data bus, the CPU can instantly read and write instructions from primary storage, enhancing processing speed. Secondary storage (like a Hard Disk) and Tertiary Storage are slower compared to primary storage and do not communicate directly with the CPU; instead, they interact through Input/Output channels.

Extra Facts:
In the computer memory hierarchy, Primary Storage sits at the top and includes RAM and ROM (Read-Only Memory). RAM is volatile memory, meaning its data is lost when power is off, while ROM is a permanent, non-volatile memory often used to store the BIOS (Basic Input/Output System). Cache Memory, located inside or very close to the CPU, is even faster than primary storage and stores the most frequently used data. The significance of the storage hierarchy is to balance cost, speed, and capacity.

प्राथमिक भण्डारण, जिसे मुख्य मेमोरी या RAM (Random Access Memory) के रूप में भी जाना जाता है, सीधे CPU के साथ इंटरैक्ट करता है। यह वह मेमोरी है जहां वर्तमान में निष्पादित हो रहे प्रोग्राम और डेटा संग्रहीत होते हैं। CPU को तेजी से डेटा एक्सेस करने के लिए इसकी आवश्यकता होती है। डेटा बस के माध्यम से सीधा कनेक्शन होने के कारण, CPU प्राथमिक भण्डारण से तुरंत निर्देश पढ़ और लिख सकता है, जिससे प्रसंस्करण की गति बढ़ जाती है। द्वितीयक भण्डारण (जैसे हार्ड डिस्क) और तृतीयक भण्डारण प्राथमिक भण्डारण की तुलना में धीमे होते हैं और CPU के साथ सीधे नहीं, बल्कि इनपुट/आउटपुट चैनलों के माध्यम से संचार करते हैं।

Extra Facts:
कंप्यूटर मेमोरी पदानुक्रम में, प्राथमिक भण्डारण सबसे ऊपर होता है और इसमें RAM और ROM (Read-Only Memory) शामिल होते हैं। RAM अस्थिर मेमोरी है, जिसका अर्थ है कि बिजली बंद होने पर इसका डेटा खो जाता है, जबकि ROM एक स्थायी, गैर-परिवर्तनशील मेमोरी है जिसका उपयोग अक्सर BIOS (Basic Input/Output System) को संग्रहीत करने के लिए किया जाता है। कैश मेमोरी, जो CPU के अंदर या उसके करीब होती है, प्राथमिक भण्डारण से भी तेज होती है और सबसे अधिक बार उपयोग किए जाने वाले डेटा को संग्रहीत करती है। भंडारण पदानुक्रम का महत्व लागत, गति और क्षमता के बीच संतुलन बनाना है।

question:
Which of the following is known as the brain of the computer?

[SSC JE Mechanical - 23/03/2021 (Shift-II)]
options: ALU
CPU
ROM
RAM
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is CPU

Explanation:
The CPU (Central Processing Unit) is known as the brain of the computer because it serves as the primary control center of the computer system. The CPU processes all instructions, performs calculations, and coordinates between various computer components. It contains the ALU (Arithmetic Logic Unit) which handles mathematical and logical operations, while the Control Unit manages instruction execution. ROM (Read Only Memory) and RAM (Random Access Memory) are memory devices that handle data storage but don't perform processing. This is why the CPU is considered the actual 'brain' of the computer.

Extra Facts:
The main components of a CPU include the Control Unit, ALU, and Registers. Clock Speed (measured in GHz) determines the processing speed of the CPU. Multi-core Processors integrate multiple CPU cores into a single chip, enhancing performance. Cache Memory is located inside the CPU and helps in quickly accessing frequently used data. Modern CPUs use Pipelining technology to process multiple instructions simultaneously.

Extra Facts:
CPU के मुख्य घटकों में Control Unit, ALU, और Registers शामिल होते हैं। Clock Speed (जैसे GHz में) CPU की प्रोसेसिंग गति निर्धारित करती है। Multi-core Processors एक से अधिक CPU कोर को एक चिप में समाहित करते हैं, जिससे प्रदर्शन बढ़ता है। Cache Memory CPU के अंदर ही होती है और यह बार-बार उपयोग होने वाले डेटा को तेजी से एक्सेस करने में मदद करती है। आधुनिक CPU Pipelining तकनीक का उपयोग करके एक साथ कई निर्देशों को प्रोसेस करते हैं।

question:
On which port of the computer do you connect the keyboard cable?

[UP Lower (M) G.S. 2015]
options: VGA port
Ethernet port
USB port
Ps/2 port
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is USB port

Explanation:
In modern computers, the keyboard cable is primarily connected to the USB (Universal Serial Bus) port. USB is a standard interface that provides plug-and-play functionality, allowing devices to be connected and removed while the computer is running. The VGA port is used for monitor connections, the Ethernet port is used for network connections, and the PS/2 port was used for keyboards and mice in older computers. Due to the widespread adoption and universal compatibility of USB, it has become the most common port for keyboard connections today.

Extra Facts:
The USB standard was introduced in 1996 and has become the primary method for connecting peripheral devices to computers. USB has various versions such as USB 1.1, 2.0, 3.0, and 3.1, each with different data transfer speeds. The PS/2 port, developed by IBM, is no longer found in most modern computers. USB-C is the latest connector that offers reversible plug orientation and allows for faster data transfer.

☛ Which port is used to connect to the internet? → Ethernet port
☛ What is the most common port for connecting printers? → USB port

☛ What is the full form of USB? → Universal Serial Bus

question:
In what form is data stored in a computer?

[UPSSSC Lower-1 (2015)]
options: Octal
Hexa-decimal
Decimal
Binary
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Binary

Explanation:
Data is stored in a computer in binary form, which is based on only two digits: 0 and 1. This is because the electronic circuits of a computer can only recognize two states: ON (1) and OFF (0). Each binary digit is called a bit, and eight bits combine to form a byte. All types of data - text, images, audio, video - are ultimately converted into binary code to be stored and processed in a computer. Other options like decimal, hexadecimal, or octal are human-readable representations, but the underlying storage is always in binary.

Extra Facts:
The binary system is also called the base-2 number system. John Vincent Atanasoff is credited with building the first electronic digital computer, which used the binary system. Character encoding standards like ASCII (American Standard Code for Information Interchange) and Unicode assign a unique binary code to each character. Hexadecimal and octal systems are used by programmers to represent binary values in a shortened form, as they are easier for humans to understand and write compared to binary.

कंप्यूटर में डाटा का भंडारण बाइनरी फॉर्म में होता है, जो केवल दो अंकों 0 और 1 पर आधारित है। यह इसलिए क्योंकि कंप्यूटर के इलेक्ट्रॉनिक सर्किट केवल दो स्थितियों को पहचानते हैं: ON (1) और OFF (0)। प्रत्येक बाइनरी डिजिट को बिट कहा जाता है, और आठ बिट्स मिलकर एक बाइट बनाते हैं। टेक्स्ट, इमेज, ऑडियो, वीडियो - सभी प्रकार के डाटा को अंततः बाइनरी कोड में परिवर्तित करके ही कंप्यूटर में स्टोर और प्रोसेस किया जाता है। अन्य विकल्प जैसे डेसीमल, हेक्साडेसीमल, या ऑक्टल मानव-पठनीय प्रतिनिधित्व हैं, लेकिन अंतर्निहित भंडारण हमेशा बाइनरी में ही होता है।
